# Affinda

Affinda provides an AI-powered document processing platform that automates data extraction from various document types.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/affinda/.

## Actions

- **Create Collection**: Create a new collection.
- **Create Document**: Upload a new document for parsing.
- **Create Organization**: Create a new organization.
- **Create Workspace**: Create a new workspace.
- **Delete Collection**: Delete a specific collection by its id.
- **Delete Document**: Delete a specific document by its id.
- **Delete Organization**: Delete a specific organization by its id.
- **Delete Workspace**: Delete a specific workspace by its id.
- **Delete Workspace Membership**: Remove a user from a workspace by membership id.
- **Get Collection** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific collection by its id.
- **Get Collections** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all collections.
- **Get Document** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific document by its id.
- **Get Documents** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all documents.
- **Get Organization** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific organization by its id.
- **Get Organizations** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all organizations.
- **Get Workspace** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific workspace by its id.
- **Get Workspace Membership** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific workspace membership by its id.
- **Get Workspace Memberships** (read-only): List all workspace memberships for the authenticated user.
- **Get Workspaces** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all workspaces.
- **Update Collection**: Update specific fields of a collection.
- **Update Document**: Update specific fields of a document.
- **Update Workspace**: Update specific fields of a workspace.
- **Batch Update Annotations**: Update multiple annotations in one request.
- **Create RESTHook Subscription**: Create a new resthook subscription.
- **Create Tag**: Create a new tag.
- **Create Validation Result**: Create a validation result.
- **Delete Resthook Subscription**: Delete a specific resthook subscription by id.
- **Get All Validation Results** (read-only): List validation results for documents.
- **Get Annotations** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all annotations.
- **Get Document Type** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific document type by its id.
- **Get Document Types** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all document types.
- **Get Extractors** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all extractors.
- **Get Resthook Subscription** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific resthook subscription by its id.
- **Get RESTHook Subscriptions** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all resthook subscriptions.
- **Get Tags** (read-only): List all tags.
- **Get Usage by Workspace** (read-only): Retrieve monthly credits consumption for a workspace.
- **Update Document Data**: Update parsed data for a resume or job description document.
- **Update Organization**: Update specific fields of an organization.
- **Update RESTHook Subscription**: Update an existing resthook subscription.
